levers.name: ACCUM
levers.effect: Number of backward passes to accumulate before an optimizer step. Was gated on `(step + 1) % ACCUM == 0` where `step` advances per WINDOW while the gate body runs per FLUSH, so it accumulated nothing at any value; now `if _nbwd % ACCUM == 0`, counting backward passes.

levers.name: BATCH_W
levers.effect: Batch width in windows; determines flush cadence. fetch_big.py printed `BATCH_W=16 ACCUM=4` as the recommended heavy-run command while ACCUM appeared in no print anywhere.

levers.name: VMAX
levers.effect: Softmax width — preallocates emb.weight, head.weight, head.bias. A hard ceiling on the tokenizer's vocabulary because emb has exactly that many rows. pilot-add sets it to double the checkpoint's value so an added area can mint its own tokens.
levers.owner: self_organize.py geometry gate; longrun.sh pilot-add/add derive it from the checkpoint

levers.name: FAB_NMAX
levers.effect: Fabric slot pool — preallocates the five cap-shaped tensors A, B, SRC_p, K_p, cent. Was nested under `if [ -z "${FAB_N0:-}" ]` in longrun.sh so setting FAB_N0 silently reverted it to 4096.
levers.owner: self_organize.py Fabric; longrun.sh derives it from the checkpoint

levers.name: FAB_N0
levers.effect: Starting expert population. Read from the checkpoint on resume (2090 for pilot A) rather than the 2048 default, because net growth is measured as fab.n() - FAB_N0 and the default would credit the run with experts the restore brought back.

levers.name: FAB_RANK
levers.effect: Inner rank of each low-rank adapter; A is [cap, d, rank]. An INNER dimension, so it cannot be prefix-widened and a mismatch on resume is fatal by design. Was not inherited by the harness until this span.

levers.name: FAB_DK
levers.effect: Key dimension; SRC_p and K_p are [cap, dk]. Also an inner dimension, also fatal on mismatch, also newly inherited.

levers.name: GROW_CAP_FAB0
levers.effect: Explicit cap lift for the fabric. Its refusal guard was unreachable because the checkpoint's saved cap_fab was restored over the explicit request first; now the checkpoint only fills in the cap when the environment did not ask for one.

levers.name: FAB_PRESSURE
levers.effect: Setpoint for the cull gate; population equilibrates near pressure x cap. cull_gate_open(n_live, cap, pressure) gates the utilization cull, the utilization spare and FAB_RESCUE.

levers.name: FAB_CULL_FRAC
levers.effect: Fraction culled per pass. Budget was sized on n_live; now on len(_elig), the experts that have actually had their chances. Measured 18 vs 8 removed.

levers.name: DOM_CULL_FRAC
levers.effect: Fraction of domains culled per manage pass. `max(1, int(DOM_CULL_FRAC * n))` made it a MINIMUM of one for any population under ten, driving the domain population to 1. Now floored by DOM_CULL_FLOOR.

levers.name: DOM_CULL_FLOOR
levers.effect: New knob (default 1) below which the domain-cull budget is not forced to remove anything; 0 reproduces the collapse.

levers.name: MEM_SRC_FLOOR
levers.effect: Per-source memory floor (0.5) reserving cap*floor/live_sources per domain. Protects against EVICTION only; the domain cull's mem.delete_src() destroyed entries the floor forbids evicting. `nsrc > 0` is what makes a source eligible for protection at all, so the duplicate-slot undercount removed protection from the sources it exists for.

levers.name: PHASE_SCHED / PURE_ADD
levers.effect: Which processes stream in which phase. Default for NP=2 is [[0],[0],[1],[1]] (rehearsed); PURE_ADD=1 sets 1|1|1|1 so only the new area streams. The default rehearses the old area, which is what made English HELD; the pure arm is the one that tests modularity. The default also makes every non-streaming domain trip the cull's staleness test by construction.

levers.name: RATE_EVERY
levers.effect: Cadence of the rate meter, which also gates the per-process curve probe. Setting RATE_EVERY=100000 in smoke runs suppressed the curve table entirely — the assistant did this in every smoke run and so never saw the table populate.

levers.name: AMP
levers.effect: Autocast precision. Accepts bf16 and fp16, guarded on `AMP in ("bf16","fp16") and DEV == "cuda"`. fp16 is now REFUSED with a SystemExit because there is no GradScaler anywhere in the file. Not reachable by any test unless SELFTEST_DEVICE=cuda.

levers.name: DATA_MODE
levers.effect: real | synthetic. The synthetic path generates from Markov processes and holds nothing out, so VALC and CORP are undefined there. preflight.sh's END-TO-END SMOKE is the SOLE caller that sets DATA_MODE=synthetic.

levers.name: TOKENIZER_PATH
levers.effect: Had TWO jobs — the file a resume READS its parent's vocabulary from, and the file the run SAVES its own to — which caused a run to overwrite its parent's vocabulary inside runs/. Now a run's vocabulary goes beside its own checkpoint (SAVE_CKPT + ".dyntok.json") and tok_path records where it was WRITTEN.
levers.owner: self_organize.py tokenizer save/load; longrun.sh pilot-add resolution

levers.name: TOK_V0
levers.effect: Module-level baseline vocabulary size, set to TOK.vocab_size where TOK is resolved; the baseline the mint count is measured against. `tokenizer.mint`'s arming test asked "is there room NOW" at report time instead of using TOK_V0.

levers.name: TOK_ANCHOR / TOK_ANCHOR_TAU / TOK_ANCHOR_USES
levers.effect: Anchor loss weight and release schedule. ARMED AND INERT in every run: the anchor lives on ByteComposer which only exists under TOK_COMPOSE, and TOK_COMPOSE defaults to 0, so model.compose is None and the term never enters the loss. A COUPLING line now says so; the knob was NOT fixed.

levers.name: MEM_WRONG_READ
levers.effect: Gates the wrong-flag read filter. Structurally cannot gate the training loop: selfcheck() is called once, from the report, and every write resets selfcon to -1. It gates the report's own evaluations only. Reported, not fixed.

levers.name: WRITE_GATE / WRITE_TARGET / WRITE_ADAPTIVE / WRITE_QUANTILE
levers.effect: Memory write gating. Added to the [config] EFFECTIVE banner this session — previously on no line of any log. WRITE_QUANTILE=1 has NO EFFECT (a COUPLING line now states it); torch.quantile is CUDA-sensitive but sits behind WRITE_ADAPTIVE=0.

levers.name: VAL_FRAC
levers.effect: Held-out fraction, taken as the LAST slice of each corpus. Only a SAMPLE if the corpus was written in no particular order — hence the shuffle requirement in the fetchers.

levers.name: --shuffle-buffer (fetch_big.py)
levers.effect: New knob, default 10000 documents with a recorded seed, writing corpora through a shuffle reservoir so the held-out tail is a sample rather than a block. carry_forward.item: Token minting is APPEND-ONLY — an id never changes meaning, which is the property prefix-widening already rests on. A clobbered .dyntok.json is therefore recoverable exactly by truncating merges to the parent's count; verified by round trip that the truncated file segments identically on unseen bytes.
carry_forward.why: This is what made the runs/ overwrite recoverable rather than fatal, and it is the invariant the whole widening design depends on.

carry_forward.item: A checkpoint's vocabulary is part of the checkpoint. A run's vocabulary belongs beside its own checkpoint (SAVE_CKPT + ".dyntok.json"); tok_path must record where it was WRITTEN, not where it was read; a resume with SAVE_CKPT off must save no vocabulary at all, because the only file it could write is its parent's.
carry_forward.why: TOKENIZER_PATH doing double duty (read parent / save own) caused the runs/ overwrite that violated the owner's one absolute constraint.

carry_forward.item: There are TWO preallocated geometries and they must be reasoned about separately: the fabric slot pool (FAB_NMAX → A, B, SRC_p, K_p, cent) and the softmax width (VMAX → emb.weight, head.weight, head.bias). emb/head/bias are in the MODEL optimizer, so widening the softmax invalidates om's moments exactly as widening the fabric does. FAB_RANK and FAB_DK are INNER dimensions — they cannot be prefix-widened and a mismatch is fatal by design.
carry_forward.why: Treating the two geometries as one produced a latent crash at the first om.step(), and gating three unrelated derivations behind `if [ -z "${FAB_N0:-}" ]` silently reverted two of them.

carry_forward.item: A resume harness must inherit n, cap, V (vocabulary), rank and dk from the checkpoint — all five, not the three that can be widened.
